en.text: to the intent that now the manifold wisdom of God might be made known by the church to the principalities and powers in the heavenly places,
en.title: God's wisdom made known through the church

es.text: para que la multiforme sabiduría de Dios sea ahora dada a conocer por medio de la iglesia a los principados y potestades en los lugares celestiales,
es.title: La sabiduría de Dios dada a conocer por la iglesia
